name: Net Sales
description: Invoiced net sales in EUR (gross sales less discounts & promotions), converted at monthly average FX.

name: Gross Sales
description: Delivered quantity x list price, EUR.

name: Discounts
description: Trade discounts and promotional allowances, EUR.

name: Discount %
description: Discounts as % of gross sales.

name: Units
description: Delivered units (cases).

name: Orders
description: Number of distinct sales orders.

name: Order Lines
description: Number of order lines.

name: Avg Order Value
description: Net sales per order.

name: Avg Net Price per Unit
description: Net sales per delivered unit.

name: Promo Sales %
description: Share of net sales sold on promotion.

name: Active Customers
description: Customers with at least one invoice in the period.

name: Net Sales per Customer
description: Average net sales per active customer.

name: New Customers
expression:
VAR _start = MIN('Date'[Date])
VAR _end = MAX('Date'[Date])
RETURN
    IF(
        NOT ISBLANK([Net Sales]),
        COUNTROWS(
            FILTER(
                VALUES(Sales[Customer Code]),
                VAR _since = LOOKUPVALUE(Customer[Customer Since], Customer[Customer Code], Sales[Customer Code])
                RETURN _since >= _start && _since <= _end
            )
        ) + 0
    )
description: Customers acquired (CRM 'customer since' date) in the period that already placed an order.

name: Churned Customers
expression:
VAR _start = MIN('Date'[Date])
VAR _end = MAX('Date'[Date])
VAR _customers = CALCULATETABLE(VALUES(Sales[Customer Code]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'))
RETURN
    IF(
        _start <= [Last Actual Date],
        COUNTROWS(
            FILTER(
                _customers,
                VAR _churn = LOOKUPVALUE(Customer[Churn Date], Customer[Customer Code], Sales[Customer Code])
                RETURN NOT ISBLANK(_churn) && _churn >= _start && _churn <= _end
            )
        ) + 0
    )
description: Customers whose CRM churn date falls in the period.

name: Unfulfilled Demand
description: Net value of ordered quantity that was not delivered (short shipments) - lost sales opportunity.

name: Unfulfilled Demand %
description: Unfulfilled demand as % of total demand.

name: Net Sales LCY
expression:
IF(
    DISTINCTCOUNT(Sales[Functional Currency]) = 1,
    SUM(Sales[Net Sales LCY])
)
description: Net sales in the country's functional currency. Blank when several currencies are mixed. BGN history restated to EUR at 1.95583.

name: Customer Rank
expression:
IF(
    HASONEVALUE(Customer[Customer]) && NOT ISBLANK([Net Sales]),
    RANKX(ALLSELECTED(Customer[Customer]), [Net Sales], , DESC, Dense)
)
description: Rank of the customer by net sales within the current selection.

name: Cumulative Customer Share %
expression:
VAR _total = CALCULATE([Net Sales], ALLSELECTED(Customer))
VAR _current = [Net Sales]
VAR _tbl =
    FILTER(
        ADDCOLUMNS(ALLSELECTED(Customer[Customer]), "@ns", [Net Sales]),
        NOT ISBLANK([@ns])
    )
VAR _cum = SUMX(FILTER(_tbl, [@ns] >= _current), [@ns])
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(_current), DIVIDE(_cum, _total))
description: Pareto: cumulative share of net sales of customers ranked at or above the current customer.

name: Top 20% Customers Share
expression:
VAR _tbl =
    FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES(Sales[Customer Code]), "@ns", [Net Sales]), [@ns] > 0)
VAR _n = COUNTROWS(_tbl)
VAR _top = TOPN(ROUNDUP(_n * 0.2, 0), _tbl, [@ns], DESC)
RETURN DIVIDE(SUMX(_top, [@ns]), SUMX(_tbl, [@ns]))
description: Share of net sales generated by the top 20% of customers (concentration risk).

name: COGS
description: Cost of goods sold at standard cost, EUR.

name: Gross Margin
description: Net sales less COGS.

name: Gross Margin %
description: Gross margin as % of net sales.

name: Opex
expression:
IF(
    NOT (ISCROSSFILTERED('Product') || ISCROSSFILTERED(Customer) || ISCROSSFILTERED(Warehouse)),
    SUM(Opex[Actual EUR])
)
description: Operating expenses (GL actuals). Not allocated to products, customers or warehouses - blank at those levels.

name: Opex % of Sales
description: Operating expenses as % of net sales.

name: Logistics Cost % of Sales
description: Logistics & transport cost as % of net sales.

name: EBITDA
description: Gross margin less operating expenses. Available at company / country / period level.

name: EBITDA %
description: EBITDA margin.

name: Budget Net Sales
expression: IF(NOT (ISFILTERED('Product') || ISCROSSFILTERED(Customer) || ISCROSSFILTERED(Warehouse)), SUM(Budget[Budget Net Sales EUR]))
description: FP&A budget net sales (set at month x country x category).

name: Budget Gross Margin
expression: IF(NOT (ISFILTERED('Product') || ISCROSSFILTERED(Customer) || ISCROSSFILTERED(Warehouse)), SUM(Budget[Budget Gross Margin EUR]))
description: FP&A budget gross margin.

name: Budget COGS
description: Budget cost of goods sold.

name: Budget Gross Margin %
description: Budget gross margin %.

name: Budget Opex
description: Budget operating expenses.

name: Budget EBITDA
description: Budget EBITDA.

name: Budget EBITDA %
description: Budget EBITDA margin.

name: Budget Net Sales (Closed Periods)
expression: CALCULATE([Budget Net Sales], KEEPFILTERS('Date'[Is Actual Period] = TRUE()))
description: Budget for the months that already have actuals - the like-for-like comparison base.

name: Budget Gross Margin (Closed Periods)
expression: CALCULATE([Budget Gross Margin], KEEPFILTERS('Date'[Is Actual Period] = TRUE()))
description: Budget gross margin for closed months.

name: Budget EBITDA (Closed Periods)
expression: CALCULATE([Budget EBITDA], KEEPFILTERS('Date'[Is Actual Period] = TRUE()))
description: Budget EBITDA for closed months.

name: Net Sales vs Budget
expression: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Net Sales]) && NOT ISBLANK([Budget Net Sales (Closed Periods)]), [Net Sales] - [Budget Net Sales (Closed Periods)])
description: Actual net sales minus budget (closed months only).

name: Net Sales vs Budget %
expression: DIVIDE([Net Sales vs Budget], [Budget Net Sales (Closed Periods)])
description: Net sales variance to budget, %.

name: Budget Achievement %
description: Actual net sales as % of budget (closed months).

name: Gross Margin vs Budget
expression: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Gross Margin]) && NOT ISBLANK([Budget Gross Margin (Closed Periods)]), [Gross Margin] - [Budget Gross Margin (Closed Periods)])
description: Gross margin variance to budget (closed months).

name: Gross Margin % vs Budget (pp)
expression:
VAR _b = DIVIDE([Budget Gross Margin (Closed Periods)], [Budget Net Sales (Closed Periods)])
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK([Gross Margin %]) && NOT ISBLANK(_b), ([Gross Margin %] - _b) * 100)
description: Gross margin % difference to budget in percentage points.

name: EBITDA vs Budget
expression: IF(NOT ISBLANK([EBITDA]) && NOT ISBLANK([Budget EBITDA (Closed Periods)]), [EBITDA] - [Budget EBITDA (Closed Periods)])
description: EBITDA variance to budget (closed months).

name: OTIF %
description: Order lines delivered on time AND in full (lines with an invalid delivery date excluded).

name: On-Time %
description: Order lines delivered on or before the promised date.

name: In-Full %
description: Order lines delivered with the full ordered quantity.

name: Fill Rate %
description: Delivered units / ordered units.

name: OTIF Target
description: Service-level target for OTIF.

name: OTIF vs Target (pp)
description: OTIF gap to target, percentage points.

name: Avg Lead Time (days)
description: Average days from order to delivery.

name: Late Lines
description: Order lines delivered after the promised date.

name: Inventory Value
expression:
VAR _lastSnapshot = CALCULATE(MAX(Inventory[Snapshot Date]), ALL(Inventory), VALUES('Date'[Date]))
RETURN CALCULATE(SUM(Inventory[On Hand Value EUR]), 'Date'[Date] = _lastSnapshot)
description: Closing inventory value at standard cost (semi-additive: last month-end in the period).

name: Inventory Units
expression:
VAR _lastSnapshot = CALCULATE(MAX(Inventory[Snapshot Date]), ALL(Inventory), VALUES('Date'[Date]))
RETURN CALCULATE(SUM(Inventory[On Hand Qty]), 'Date'[Date] = _lastSnapshot)
description: Closing inventory units (last month-end in the period).

name: Days of Inventory
expression:
VAR _lastSnapshot = CALCULATE(MAX(Inventory[Snapshot Date]), ALL(Inventory), VALUES('Date'[Date]))
VAR _period = DATESINPERIOD('Date'[Date], _lastSnapshot, -3, MONTH)
VAR _cogs = CALCULATE([COGS], _period)
VAR _days = COUNTROWS(_period)
RETURN DIVIDE([Inventory Value], DIVIDE(_cogs, _days))
description: Closing inventory / average daily COGS of the trailing 3 months.

name: Stockout Days
description: SKU x warehouse days out of stock.

name: Stockout Days per SKU
description: Average stock-out days per SKU-warehouse-month.

name: Aged Stock Value
expression:
VAR _lastSnapshot = CALCULATE(MAX(Inventory[Snapshot Date]), ALL(Inventory), VALUES('Date'[Date]))
RETURN CALCULATE(SUM(Inventory[On Hand Value EUR]), 'Date'[Date] = _lastSnapshot, Inventory[Stock Status] = "Discontinued (aged)")
description: Closing value of stock of discontinued SKUs (obsolescence risk).

name: Aged Stock %
description: Aged stock as % of inventory value.

name: Last Actual Date
description: Reporting cut-off: last day of the last closed month.

name: Net Sales PY
description: Net sales in the same period last year (like-for-like: only months that are closed in the current year).

name: Net Sales YoY
expression: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Net Sales]) && NOT ISBLANK([Net Sales PY]), [Net Sales] - [Net Sales PY])
description: Net sales change vs prior year.

name: Net Sales YoY %
description: Net sales growth vs prior year.

name: Net Sales YTD
description: Year-to-date net sales.

name: Net Sales PY YTD
description: Prior-year year-to-date net sales (same months).

name: Net Sales YTD YoY %
expression: DIVIDE([Net Sales YTD] - [Net Sales PY YTD], [Net Sales PY YTD])
description: Year-to-date growth vs prior year.

name: Net Sales R12M
expression:
VAR _end = MIN(MAX('Date'[Date]), [Last Actual Date])
RETURN CALCULATE([Net Sales], DATESINPERIOD('Date'[Date], _end, -12, MONTH))
description: Rolling 12-month net sales ending at the last closed date in context.

name: Gross Margin PY
description: Gross margin, same period last year.

name: Gross Margin YoY %
expression: DIVIDE([Gross Margin] - [Gross Margin PY], [Gross Margin PY])
description: Gross margin growth vs prior year.

name: Gross Margin % PY
description: Gross margin %, same period last year.

name: Gross Margin % YoY (pp)
expression: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Gross Margin %]) && NOT ISBLANK([Gross Margin % PY]), ([Gross Margin %] - [Gross Margin % PY]) * 100)
description: Gross margin % change vs prior year, percentage points.

name: EBITDA PY
description: EBITDA, same period last year.

name: EBITDA YoY %
description: EBITDA growth vs prior year.

name: EBITDA % PY
description: EBITDA margin, same period last year.

name: Units PY
description: Units, same period last year.

name: Active Customers PY
description: Active customers, same period last year.

name: OTIF % PY
description: OTIF, same period last year.

name: Net Sales @ PY FX
description: Current-period local-currency sales translated at prior-year FX rates (constant currency).

name: FX Impact
expression: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Net Sales]), [Net Sales] - [Net Sales @ PY FX])
description: Translation effect of exchange-rate movements on EUR net sales.

name: Constant Currency Growth %
expression: DIVIDE([Net Sales @ PY FX] - [Net Sales PY], [Net Sales PY])
description: Net sales growth excluding FX translation effects.

name: Volume Effect
expression:
VAR _unitsCY = [Units]
VAR _unitsPY = [Units PY]
VAR _avgPricePY = DIVIDE([Net Sales PY], _unitsPY)
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(_unitsPY) && NOT ISBLANK(_unitsCY), (_unitsCY - _unitsPY) * _avgPricePY)
description: Change in net sales explained by total volume at prior-year average price.

name: Price Effect
expression:
IF(
    NOT ISBLANK([Net Sales PY]) && NOT ISBLANK([Net Sales]),
    SUMX(
        VALUES('Product'[SKU]),
        VAR _uCY = [Units]
        VAR _uPY = [Units PY]
        VAR _pCY = DIVIDE([Net Sales @ PY FX], _uCY)
        VAR _pPY = DIVIDE([Net Sales PY], _uPY)
        RETURN IF(_uCY > 0 && _uPY > 0, _uCY * (_pCY - _pPY))
    )
)
description: Net price realisation (list price & discount changes) per SKU at constant FX.

name: FX Effect
description: FX translation effect (bridge step).

name: Mix & Other Effect
expression:
IF(
    NOT ISBLANK([Net Sales PY]) && NOT ISBLANK([Net Sales]),
    [Net Sales] - [Net Sales PY] - [Volume Effect] - [Price Effect] - [FX Effect]
)
description: Residual: product / customer mix, new and discontinued SKUs.

name: Bridge Value
expression:
SWITCH(
    SELECTEDVALUE('Bridge Step'[Step]),
    "Net Sales PY", [Net Sales PY],
    "Volume", [Volume Effect],
    "Price", [Price Effect],
    "Mix & Other", [Mix & Other Effect],
    "FX", [FX Effect]
)
description: Value of each step of the net sales bridge (use with 'Bridge Step'[Step] in a waterfall).

name: Forecast Net Sales
description: ETS statistical forecast of net sales for open months (Oct 2026 onwards).

name: Forecast Lower 80
expression:
VAR _f = [Forecast Net Sales]
VAR _err = SQRT(SUMX(FILTER(Forecast, Forecast[Forecast Type] = "Forward"), (Forecast[Forecast EUR] - Forecast[Lower 80]) ^ 2))
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(_f), _f - _err)
description: Lower bound of the 80% prediction interval (series errors combined in quadrature).

name: Forecast Upper 80
expression:
VAR _f = [Forecast Net Sales]
VAR _err = SQRT(SUMX(FILTER(Forecast, Forecast[Forecast Type] = "Forward"), (Forecast[Upper 80] - Forecast[Forecast EUR]) ^ 2))
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(_f), _f + _err)
description: Upper bound of the 80% prediction interval.

name: Forecast Lower 95
expression:
VAR _f = [Forecast Net Sales]
VAR _err = SQRT(SUMX(FILTER(Forecast, Forecast[Forecast Type] = "Forward"), (Forecast[Forecast EUR] - Forecast[Lower 95]) ^ 2))
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(_f), _f - _err)
description: Lower bound of the 95% prediction interval.

name: Forecast Upper 95
expression:
VAR _f = [Forecast Net Sales]
VAR _err = SQRT(SUMX(FILTER(Forecast, Forecast[Forecast Type] = "Forward"), (Forecast[Upper 95] - Forecast[Forecast EUR]) ^ 2))
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(_f), _f + _err)
description: Upper bound of the 95% prediction interval.

name: Forecast Line
expression:
VAR _monthEnd = MAX('Date'[Date])
VAR _lastActual = [Last Actual Date]
RETURN
    IF(
        _monthEnd = _lastActual,
        [Net Sales],
        [Forecast Net Sales]
    )
description: Forecast series for charts, anchored on the last actual month so the line is continuous.

name: Back-test Forecast
description: Out-of-sample forecast for Apr-Sep 2026 (model trained on data up to Mar 2026).

name: Back-test Actual
expression:
VAR _months = CALCULATETABLE(VALUES(Forecast[Month]), Forecast[Forecast Type] = "Back-test")
RETURN CALCULATE([Net Sales], KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(_months, 'Date'[Month Start])))
description: Actual net sales for the back-test months only (Apr-Sep 2026).

name: Back-test Error %
expression:
VAR _f = [Back-test Forecast]
VAR _a = [Back-test Actual]
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(_f) && NOT ISBLANK(_a), DIVIDE(_f - _a, _a))
description: Back-test forecast vs actual for the same months, % (positive = over-forecast).

name: Forecast WAPE
expression:
CALCULATE(
    DIVIDE(SUM('Forecast Accuracy'[Abs Error EUR]), SUM('Forecast Accuracy'[Actual EUR])),
    'Forecast Accuracy'[Model] = "ETS (damped trend)"
)
description: Weighted absolute % error of the ETS model on the 6-month hold-out.

name: Naive WAPE
expression:
CALCULATE(
    DIVIDE(SUM('Forecast Accuracy'[Abs Error EUR]), SUM('Forecast Accuracy'[Actual EUR])),
    'Forecast Accuracy'[Model] = "Seasonal naive"
)
description: Weighted absolute % error of the seasonal-naive benchmark (same month last year).

name: Forecast Value Added (pp)
description: Error reduction of the ETS model vs the naive benchmark, percentage points.

name: Forecast Accuracy %
description: 1 - WAPE.

name: FY Outlook
description: Latest estimate: actuals for closed months + statistical forecast for open months.

name: FY Outlook vs Budget
expression: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Budget Net Sales]), [FY Outlook] - [Budget Net Sales])
description: Latest estimate minus full-period budget.

name: FY Outlook vs Budget %
expression: DIVIDE([FY Outlook vs Budget], [Budget Net Sales])
description: Latest estimate vs budget, %.

name: FY Outlook vs PY %
expression:
VAR _py = CALCULATE([Net Sales], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR('Date'[Date]))
RETURN DIVIDE([FY Outlook] - _py, _py)
description: Latest estimate vs full prior-year actuals.

name: Price Change %
description: Selected what-if price change.

name: Volume Change %
description: Selected what-if volume change.

name: Cost Inflation %
description: Selected what-if COGS inflation.

name: R12M Gross Margin %
expression:
VAR _end = [Last Actual Date]
RETURN CALCULATE([Gross Margin %], DATESINPERIOD('Date'[Date], _end, -12, MONTH), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'))
description: Gross margin % of the last 12 closed months (basis for open-period margin).

name: R12M Opex % of Sales
expression:
VAR _end = [Last Actual Date]
RETURN CALCULATE([Opex % of Sales], DATESINPERIOD('Date'[Date], _end, -12, MONTH), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'))
description: Opex % of sales of the last 12 closed months (basis for open-period opex).

name: Outlook Gross Margin (Base)
description: Actual gross margin + forecast net sales x trailing GM %.

name: Outlook EBITDA (Base)
expression:
IF(
    NOT (ISCROSSFILTERED('Product') || ISCROSSFILTERED(Customer) || ISCROSSFILTERED(Warehouse)),
    [Outlook Gross Margin (Base)] - [Opex] - [Forecast Net Sales] * [R12M Opex % of Sales]
)
description: Latest-estimate EBITDA before scenario adjustments.

name: Scenario Net Sales
description: Latest estimate with what-if price and volume changes applied to open periods.

name: Scenario Gross Margin
expression:
VAR _fc = [Forecast Net Sales]
VAR _cogsOpen = _fc * (1 - [R12M Gross Margin %]) * (1 + [Volume Change %]) * (1 + [Cost Inflation %])
VAR _salesOpen = _fc * (1 + [Price Change %]) * (1 + [Volume Change %])
RETURN [Gross Margin] + _salesOpen - _cogsOpen
description: Scenario gross margin: price changes flow to margin, volume scales COGS, cost inflation raises COGS.

name: Scenario EBITDA
expression:
IF(
    NOT (ISCROSSFILTERED('Product') || ISCROSSFILTERED(Customer) || ISCROSSFILTERED(Warehouse)),
    VAR _opexOpen = [Forecast Net Sales] * [R12M Opex % of Sales] * (1 + 0.6 * [Volume Change %])
    RETURN [Scenario Gross Margin] - [Opex] - _opexOpen
)
description: Scenario EBITDA. Assumes 60% of opex is variable with volume.

name: Scenario EBITDA %
description: Scenario EBITDA margin.

name: Scenario Net Sales Impact
description: Scenario minus base latest estimate.

name: Scenario EBITDA Impact
description: Scenario EBITDA minus base.

name: DQ Checks
description: Number of data-quality rules executed.

name: DQ Checks Passed
description: Rules within tolerance.

name: DQ Checks Warning
description: Rules above tolerance (up to 5x).

name: DQ Checks Failed
description: Rules above 5x tolerance.

name: DQ Rule Pass Rate
description: Share of rules passing.

name: Record Accuracy %
expression: 1 - DIVIDE(SUM('DQ Checks'[Rows Failed]), SUM('DQ Checks'[Rows Checked]))
description: 1 - failed records / checked records across all rules.

name: DQ Exception Rows
description: Row-level exceptions logged by the ETL.

name: Feeds Loaded Late
expression: CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('DQ Load Log'), 'DQ Load Log'[SLA Status] = "Late") + 0
description: Country feeds loaded after the 3-day SLA.

name: Feed SLA %
expression: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('DQ Load Log'), 'DQ Load Log'[SLA Status] = "Within SLA"), COUNTROWS('DQ Load Log'))
description: Share of feeds loaded within SLA.

name: Imputed Discount Lines
description: Order lines where a missing discount was imputed (DQ05).

name: Estimated COGS Share
description: Share of COGS estimated for unmapped SKUs (DQ02).

name: Data As Of
expression: "Data as of " & FORMAT([Last Actual Date], "d mmm yyyy")
description: Reporting cut-off label.

name: Color YoY
description: Green/red by YoY sign.

name: Color vs Budget
description: Green/red by budget variance.

name: Color OTIF
description: Traffic light vs OTIF target (>= 95% green, >= 88% amber, else red).

name: Color DQ Status
description: Traffic light for data-quality status.

name: Color Scenario EBITDA
description: Green/red by scenario impact.

name: KPI Net Sales YoY Label
expression:
VAR _v = [Net Sales YoY %]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_v), "", IF(_v >= 0, "▲ ", "▼ ") & FORMAT(ABS(_v), "0.0%") & " vs PY")
description: Arrow label for KPI cards.

name: KPI Net Sales vs Budget Label
expression:
VAR _v = [Net Sales vs Budget %]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_v), "", IF(_v >= 0, "▲ ", "▼ ") & FORMAT(ABS(_v), "0.0%") & " vs budget")
description: Arrow label for KPI cards.

name: KPI GM pp Label
expression:
VAR _v = [Gross Margin % YoY (pp)]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_v), "", IF(_v >= 0, "▲ ", "▼ ") & FORMAT(ABS(_v), "0.0") & " pp vs PY")
description: Arrow label for KPI cards.

name: KPI EBITDA Label
expression:
VAR _v = [EBITDA YoY %]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_v), "", IF(_v >= 0, "▲ ", "▼ ") & FORMAT(ABS(_v), "0.0%") & " vs PY")
description: Arrow label for KPI cards.

name: KPI OTIF Label
expression:
VAR _v = [OTIF vs Target (pp)]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_v), "", IF(_v >= 0, "▲ ", "▼ ") & FORMAT(ABS(_v), "0.0") & " pp vs 95% target")
description: Arrow label for KPI cards.

name: Selected Period
expression:
VAR _min = MIN('Date'[Date])
VAR _max = MIN(MAX('Date'[Date]), [Last Actual Date])
RETURN
    IF(
        _max < _min,
        "Open period (forecast only)",
        FORMAT(_min, "mmm yyyy") & IF(FORMAT(_min, "yyyymm") <> FORMAT(_max, "yyyymm"), " – " & FORMAT(_max, "mmm yyyy"))
    )
description: Closed months covered by the current date selection, e.g. 'Jan 2026 – Sep 2026'.

name: Executive Summary
expression:
VAR _ns = [Net Sales]
VAR _yoy = [Net Sales YoY %]
VAR _ccy = [Constant Currency Growth %]
VAR _vb = [Net Sales vs Budget]
VAR _gm = [Gross Margin %]
VAR _gmpp = [Gross Margin % YoY (pp)]
VAR _ebitda = [EBITDA %]
VAR _otif = [OTIF %]
VAR _ctry =
    ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES(Country[Country]), "@yoy", [Net Sales YoY], "@vb", [Net Sales vs Budget])
VAR _topGrowth = TOPN(1, _ctry, [@yoy], DESC)
VAR _worstBudget = TOPN(1, _ctry, [@vb], ASC)
VAR _fmtM = "€#,0,,.0""M"""
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(_ns),
        "No closed-period data for the current selection.",
        "Net sales of " & FORMAT(_ns, _fmtM) & " are " & FORMAT(_yoy, "+0.0%;-0.0%") & " vs prior year ("
            & FORMAT(_ccy, "+0.0%;-0.0%") & " at constant FX) and " & FORMAT(_vb, "+€#,0,,.0""M"";-€#,0,,.0""M""")
            & " vs budget. Gross margin is " & FORMAT(_gm, "0.0%") & " (" & FORMAT(_gmpp, "+0.0;-0.0") & " pp YoY), EBITDA margin "
            & FORMAT(_ebitda, "0.0%") & " and OTIF " & FORMAT(_otif, "0.0%") & ". "
            & IF(COUNTROWS(_ctry) > 1,
                "Largest growth contributor: " & MAXX(_topGrowth, Country[Country]) & " (" & FORMAT(MAXX(_topGrowth, [@yoy]), "+€#,0,,.0""M"";-€#,0,,.0""M""")
                & "). Largest budget gap: " & MAXX(_worstBudget, Country[Country]) & " (" & FORMAT(MAXX(_worstBudget, [@vb]), "+€#,0,,.0""M"";-€#,0,,.0""M""") & ").",
                "")
    )
description: Auto-generated narrative of the headline KPIs for the current selection.
